nodes.title: Broder's alternating expansion of the r-Stirling numbers of the first kind

nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $m$ and $r$, the unsigned $r$-Stirling number of the first kind $[r, m]_r$ equals $1$ if $m = r$ and $0$ otherwise: when the first index equals $r$, the product in the definition is empty, so the polynomial is $x^r$.
nodes.title: Initial row of the r-Stirling numbers of the first kind

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $n$, $m$ and $r$ with $1 \le r \le n$, the unsigned $r$-Stirling numbers of the first kind $[n, m]_r$ satisfy $[n+1, m]_r = [n, m-1]_r + n \, [n, m]_r$, where for $m = 0$ the term $[n, m-1]_r$ is read as $[n, 0]_r$.
nodes.title: Recurrence for the r-Stirling numbers of the first kind

nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $N$ and $r$ with $r \ge 1$, the unsigned $r$-Stirling number of the first kind $[N, 0]_r$ is $0$: the defining polynomial is divisible by $x$, so its constant coefficient vanishes.
nodes.title: Vanishing of the r-Stirling numbers of the first kind with second index zero

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $n$, $m$ and $r$, the unsigned $r$-Stirling number of the first kind $[n, m]_r$ is the coefficient of $x^m$ in the polynomial with natural-number coefficients

nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $n$ and $r$, the r-Stirling number of the second kind ${n+r \brace r}_r$ equals $r^n$ (with $0^0 = 1$).

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
